knot_insert.limits: Exact interior B-spline insertion; nonperiodic tested.

knot_remove.limits: Native removal with a requested tolerance; can reject removal.

degree_reduce.limits: Single nonrational Bezier span; constrained LS and 2048 off-grid checks, sampled error only.

curve_split.limits: Exact two-way split strictly inside the domain.

fit_curve.limits: Nonperiodic cubic least squares, chord parameters, fixed endpoints.

fair_curve.limits: Penalized second control-pole differences; fixed endpoints, no interpolation promise.

sweep_guided.limits: CUDA projected guide rail defines profile frame; nonzero projected rail required.

sweep_scaled.limits: CUDA positive scalar per path station; <=32 stations and <=31 corners.

sweep_variable.limits: CUDA compatible polygon profile per station; bilinear side sheet, no self-intersection guarantee.

sweep_closed.limits: CUDA RMF holonomy distributed by chord length; duplicate endpoint/profile/scale; G0 closed seam, no continuous G1 guarantee.

loft_compatible.limits: Exact degree/knot/domain harmonization then native loft; caller supplies matching orientation/correspondence.

surface_extend.limits: Exact polynomial U extrapolation of a nonrational Bezier patch with original [0,1] domain.

surface_untrim.limits: Rebuild the natural support-domain face; does not restore discarded upstream geometry.

surface_replace.limits: Isolated untrimmed rectangular patch, matching sampled boundary; arbitrary solid-face replacement excluded.

match_g1.limits: Compatible bicubic Bezier U border, same V orientation; positive derivative scale. Unit scale tested C1.

match_g2.limits: Same compatible border; position/D1/D2 rows matched. Unit scale tested C2.

fair_patches.limits: Joint 7x4 composite net; <=64 projected bending-gradient steps, C2-compatible locked outer boundary and orthogonal seam projection.

surface_quality.limits: Sampled Jacobian/principal curvature diagnostics; not global regularity/Class-A certification.

fillet.limits: Native selected-edge constant positive radius; infeasible blends reject.

variable_fillet.limits: Native linear R1/R2 law along selected contour; positive feasible radii.

thicken.limits: Native simple face/shell offset and side walls; no general offset self-intersection solver.

shell.limits: Native remove-selected-face and join offset; feasible test box, negative inward thickness.

draft.limits: Native planar/cylindrical/conical face draft, abs(angle)<45deg, explicit neutral plane.

rib.limits: Thicken an explicit planar rib profile and Boolean-fuse with base; not automatic skeleton ribs.

decimate.limits: CPU shortest-edge collapse; closed oriented manifold, link/no-flip tests and vertex-displacement budget; not a Hausdorff guarantee.

adaptive_remesh.limits: CPU conforming length-driven midpoint refinement; piecewise planar geometry preserved; <=16 passes.

edge_flip.limits: CPU two-triangle planar convex interior edge; reject duplicate diagonal.

bridge_loops.limits: CPU disjoint equally sized oriented boundary loops with caller correspondence; may return open surface.

region_extrude.limits: CPU selected triangle region translated outward with boundary walls; vector must point out of every selected face.

crease_subdivide.limits: CPU one Loop step with hard edge/boundary rules and >=3-crease corner lock.

self_intersection_detect.limits: CPU nonadjacent triangle crossing pairs; O(T^2), coplanar overlapping candidate rejects as unsupported.

self_intersection_repair.limits: CPU explicit face-discard policy covering detected crossings; reports open result, no automatic closed reconstruction.

nonmanifold_repair.limits: CPU vertex-fan splitting, same face geometry, explicit new boundaries.

tolerance_unify.limits: Copied native shape tolerances 1e-9..1e-3 mm; does not heal larger geometric gaps.

small_feature_cleanup.limits: Native same-domain unification and small-edge/wireframe repair; coplanar sliver test. Arbitrary curved sliver removal not guaranteed.

stable_handles.limits: Typed feature ids stable through parameter/history/save-load; never reused in live graph.

select_subshape.limits: Unique geometric centroid point/edge/face query; revision-stale or ambiguous selections reject.

feature_dag.limits: Typed DAG, cycle rejection, descendant-only invalidation and memoized execution.

history_undo.limits: Undo graph edit, clear caches, invalidate all prior subshape selections.

history_redo.limits: Redo graph edit; branching edit clears redo.

feature_rebuild.limits: Deterministic registered operations and JSON graph; same geometry checked after fresh load/rebuild.
